readings: For each non-null orders.timespan value represented by an order matched to at least one riskandmargin record on riskandmargin.ordervault = orders.recordvault, show the time-in-force value, the count of distinct matched orders, that count divided by the sum of those counts across the represented values, and the difference between that share and the arithmetic mean of the shares across those represented values. Drop unmatched risk/margin records and do not round.

For each non-null orders.timespan value occurring in orders, show the time-in-force value, the count of distinct orders matched to at least one riskandmargin record on riskandmargin.ordervault = orders.recordvault (zero if none), that count divided by the sum of those counts across all time-in-force values occurring in orders, and the difference between that share and the arithmetic mean of the shares across those values. Drop unmatched risk/margin records and do not round.
queries:
WITH matched_counts AS (
    SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS order_count
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN riskandmargin AS r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
    WHERE o.timespan IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY o.timespan
),
shares AS (
    SELECT
        timespan,
        order_count,
        1.0 * order_count / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM matched_counts
)
SELECT
    timespan,
    order_count,
    share,
    share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_difference
FROM shares

WITH matched_counts AS (
  SELECT
    o.timespan,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.ordervault IS NOT NULL THEN o.orderspivot END) AS matched_order_count
  FROM orders AS o
  LEFT JOIN riskandmargin AS r
    ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  WHERE o.timespan IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
shares AS (
  SELECT
    timespan,
    matched_order_count,
    1.0 * matched_order_count / SUM(matched_order_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM matched_counts
)
SELECT
  timespan,
  matched_order_count,
  share,
  share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference_from_mean_share
FROM shares
